requirements.requirement: Reusable Item Definition and Asset Instance identities remain distinct wherever both are shown.
Definition variant/configuration, live Asset Instance, mutable state, and knowledge state never silently replace source identity.
Display-name equality never authorizes identity merge or source resolution.
Source facts, source-unspecified values, reference-only records, conflicts, inference, and owner-delegated recommendations remain distinguishable.
All 53 recovered R1 Item-classified candidates remain accounted for without automatic canonical promotion.
The obsolete 487-object semantic-parse database is not used as Item-content completeness authority.
Ownership, custody, possession, control, access, and usage authority remain independent relations.
Equipment, installation, attunement, or bond assignment never silently transfers ownership.
Lending/transfer dialogs state exactly which authority relations change before commit.
Containment is acyclic and moves validate destination capacity/compatibility before commit.
Unauthorized hidden contents are filtered before child counts, total weight/value, occupancy, capacity summaries, search, export, diagnostics, or AI context.
Container movement has a non-drag keyboard/touch/nonvisual command path.
Stack merge requires governed compatibility across identity/version/state/quality/provenance/ownership/restrictions as applicable.
Split/merge preserves attributable lot lineage and cannot erase ownership or source provenance.
Equipment/loadout validates slot/hand/layer/host/station/attunement compatibility and applicable requirements.
Equipping an Asset never rewrites Character or Item source Definition mechanics.
Current ammunition/charges/doses are separate from governed maximum capacity/configuration.
Seven source-unspecified energy-weapon capacity records remain unknown/source-unspecified rather than zero, unlimited, or fabricated.
Energy Sniper Rifle, Plasma Carbine, and Cryo Blaster reference-only names cannot be selected as complete weapon Definitions until governed Definitions exist.
Denied or failed-before-commit use/reload/recharge/consume operations spend no authoritative inventory resource.
Hidden/unrevealed loot contributes no existence, count, value, weight, source, relationship, or diagnostic clue to unauthorized roles.
Discovery/identification changes future knowledge projection without rewriting underlying true Definition/Asset state.
Shop/cart/trade proposal state is non-authoritative until an explicit transaction commits.
Accepted transaction updates exact Assets/lots/authority relations and consideration atomically according to the governing profile.
Private offers, hidden stock, and unrelated holdings are excluded before counts, suggestions, or transaction projections.
Durability/condition semantics are profile-driven; zero durability does not universally delete an Asset.
Repair/maintenance changes current state while preserving prior damage, repair, and provenance history.
Crafting/salvage reserves exact inputs/quantities and prevents competing accepted double-spend.
Cancelled/failed work orders consume no inputs and create no authoritative outputs.
Successful transformation preserves lineage from exact inputs/work order to outputs/byproducts.
Living/sentient items preserve Asset identity while autonomy, bond, progression, and capability relationships remain explicit.
Symbiote/cybernetic Asset behavior remains distinct from host biology/form consequences routed to PPIA-05.
EVA chassis, loose module, installed module, wearer, interface, and consumable identities/relations remain distinguishable.
Software-like Assets are not forced into physical carried-weight/container semantics when their profile is non-physical.
Authorization precedes search, counts, aggregates, relationships, provenance, history, exports, diagnostics, and AI/service retrieval.
GM, Assistant GM, Owner/Admin, Player, Creator, and service/AI projections preserve their scoped authority without implicit elevation.
Every authoritative Item/Asset mutation is idempotent and expected-version checked or governed by an equivalent concurrency contract.
Ambiguous network outcomes query command/operation status using the same operation ID before any retry.
Reconnect revalidates current identity, Campaign, role, permissions, entitlements, pack/version, and lifecycle; cached hidden/revoked fields cannot restore authority.

Every core Item/Inventory operation works through keyboard/touch/screen-reader-equivalent controls and preserves essential status at compact/mobile and high-zoom layouts without relying on color or motion.
